    "Model forecasts are systematically below true prices, showing 0.8-1.2% daily bias to the downside",

    "When sentiment is strongly negative (0.00-0.33), model under-predicts the floor by ~0.1-0.2 points relative to true lows",
    "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias at extremes, over-smoothing 0.2-0.3 point daily movements that reflect more volatility",
    "Sentiment strength (1.00 vs 0.67) correlates with 0.1-0.2 point price advantage in model's third- to fifth-day forecast horizon"
